name: Mashima Saki
source: The principal of this school that Souichirou works at. She organizes "Love Lab" and put Souichirou in charge of being the "master". Using threats and coercion she convinces [url=/c7526]Yuuri[/url], [url=/c7527]Kaname[/url] and [url=/c7525]Hinata[/url] to join. She often yells at Souichirou when he doesn't make progress fast enough with his 'slaves'.
